Initial release of YouTube Video Editor — Edit and Export YouTube Videos.

- Upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe editing needs to get polished results in minutes.
- AI handles trimming, transitions, background music syncing, exports, and more via remote GPU nodes.
- Simple connection flow with free starter tokens and session management; no installation required.
- Supports batch processing, timeline previews, and iterative edits within the same session.
- Clear error handling, attribution requirements, and support for popular media formats.
- Export finished videos in 1080p MP4 and other formats optimized for YouTube.
